seo.title: Sell With Us
seo.description: Free valuations, no seller’s commission and a 2% + VAT loss and damage waiver fee only if your item sells.

hero.title: Seller's Guide
hero.text: Whether you wish to sell a single object or the entire contents of a house, Sloane Street Auctions offers expertise and experience to help you realise the highest possible price.

photo.alt: A specialist examining an object or painting, close up, in warm low light

steps.title: Free valuation
steps.body: We conduct free valuations, Monday to Friday. You can visit our Chelsea saleroom, arrange a home valuation, or complete a form by clicking 'Request a valuation'.

steps.title: We confirm if it’s right for sale
steps.body: A specialist reviews your item and tells you whether it suits one of our auctions, with a provisional estimate.

steps.title: Cataloguing and marketing
steps.body: Our specialists research, catalogue and photograph your item for our physical and digital catalogues.

steps.title: Sold at auction
steps.body: Your item is offered in a suitable sale. If it sells, you will be paid 35 days after the sale. If it does not sell, please contact us to discuss your options.

showroom.title: Visit us in Chelsea.
showroom.text: You are welcome to bring items to our Chelsea saleroom for consignment. Alternatively, if you would like to arrange a home valuation, please call {phone}.

photo.alt: The showroom interior on Fulham Road

fees.title: Clear terms and no seller’s commission.
fees.text: On a successful sale, a 2% + VAT loss and damage waiver fee is deducted from the hammer price. Full terms are set out in our [Conditions of Sale](https://www.sloanestreetauctions.com/terms-and-conditions). We can also broker a private sale outside the auction calendar.
